extDescription.message: Organize tabs and bookmarks into workspaces and switch fast. Also login-session switching, cross-browser sync, and tab auto-close.

commandPalette.message: Open the quick palette (current tab / bookmarks / workspace switching)

commandManager.message: Open / close the workspace manager (temporary window)

commandSaveBookmark.message: Save the current tab to the workspace bookmark folder

commandNextWorkspace.message: Switch to the next workspace in the same session

commandPrevWorkspace.message: Switch to the previous workspace in the same session
